alignmentRules.sourceFramedRule: SkinAnalyzer.calculateAlignmentFromLandmarks sourceFramed (face width >= 0.28, chin y <= 0.88, forehead y >= 0.12)

multiAngleScopeEnforcement.frontCapture: Measures forehead, nose, chin, periorbital, rightCheek, leftCheek
multiAngleScopeEnforcement.rightCapture: Measures STRICTLY leftCheek (exposed). Occluded rightCheek is out-of-scope.
multiAngleScopeEnforcement.leftCapture: Measures STRICTLY rightCheek (exposed). Occluded leftCheek is out-of-scope.
multiAngleScopeEnforcement.outOfPose: Images failing roll, pitch, yaw, or framing are OUT_OF_POSE; pimples categorized as OUT_OF_SCOPE_EXTREME_POSE.

filterComparisonSummary.description: Direct evaluation of isolated historical filter functions across 43 validation images at conf=0.70, nms=0.30

cpuBenchmark.epochThroughputReality: Actual full training step includes tile slicing, masked objectness BCE calculation, and PyTorch backward pass on CPU taking ~2406s (40.1 min) per epoch. Synthetic 5-step estimate was overly optimistic.
cpuBenchmark.budgetExecutionDecision: Trained exactly 1 epoch (~40.1 min) within interactive budget limits; transactional checkpoint saved and verified. Multi-epoch training requires dedicated GPU infrastructure.

fineTuningExperiment.interruptionReason: Stopped after Epoch 1 (2406.2s, 40.1 min) to respect interactive execution budget. Candidate weights and ONNX exported and verified.
